Metadata choreography and executed command path diverge
27 of 45 command files reference no skill path

label: Command-to-skill linkage is carried three incompatible ways: a skill_agent comment in 17 doctor command files, an ownerMode plus choreography block in 19 metadata entries, or nothing, with no command carrying both and none carrying a field the runtime reads at command time.

All 19 metadata entries declare a three-step choreography loading a hub SKILL.md, a mode SKILL.md and a presentation contract, asserting a skill-mediated execution path for every command they describe.

18 of 19 ownerMode values resolve to an existing SKILL.md; /create:skill-parent names sk-create-skill-parent with no directory and no SKILL.md while the string still appears in sk-doc/mode-registry.json, and /design:extract names sk-design-md-generator, an artefact generator rather than an extract mode.

The command files often carry none of the declared choreography: create/agent.md contains zero occurrences of sk-doc, sk-create-agent or SKILL.md and routes only to a presentation contract and a workflow YAML, while its metadata declares a two-skill load.
27 of the 45 command files reference no .skilled/skills path anywhere, so for most commands the skill linkage exists only in a metadata file no runtime reads at command time.

The flagship chat-only case is the sharpest example: /speckit:plan references two spec-kit reference cards and two spec-kit scripts and never system-spec-kit/SKILL.md, so a correct system-spec-kit recommendation does not entail the plan command mode or its gates.
Reverse linkage is nearly absent: exactly one SKILL.md (deep-research) names its commands and their relationships while 13 other skills name none, so neither direction of the mapping is closed.

A model that routes to a skill and hand-follows it produces a different process from the same command YAML workflow, because the command router never loads the skill and the skill never names the command: structural divergence, not a prompting problem.
ownerMode sk-create-skill-parent is dangling: no directory, no SKILL.md, but still listed in mode-registry.json
